pairs.source_norm: should a hazards severity scale with how exposed a character is
pairs.source_text: Should a hazard's severity scale with how exposed a character is?
pairs.target_text: No. Severity belongs to the physical event and is the same for everyone standing in it; exposure controls how many separate incidents a character is in. A collapsing wall does not hit a trained person more gently.

pairs.source_norm: when a session has a predetermined narrative event should the dice decide whether it happens
pairs.source_text: When a session has a predetermined narrative event, should the dice decide whether it happens?
pairs.target_text: No. A fixed event stays fixed and is written as a global event; what gets rolled is what the characters know about it when it lands. Understanding is the win condition, not occurrence.
